answer: Referral graphs make sybil farming pay for its own map. Every identity must attach to a referral chain. The introducer locks 100 units for 12 epochs, at most 3 endorsements per epoch. Graph density above 0.6 triggers automatic review. A fake freezes the chain and the introducer loses endorsement rights for 10 epochs. A sparrow alone looks honest; a zephyr of referrals from one node and a delta of patterns mark the cluster. Forging 1,000 identities needs 34 introducers locking 3,400 units. At 40% detection the expected loss is 13,600 units. Breakeven needs 60% survival.
